arxiv-2107-14031.title: Doctrines, modalities and comonads
arxiv-2107-14031.creator: Francesco Dagnino, Giuseppe Rosolini
arxiv-2107-14031.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Francesco Dagnino, Giuseppe Rosolini. Doctrines are categorical structures very apt to study logics of different nature within a unified environment: the 2-category 𝐃𝐭𝐧 \mathbf{Dtn} of doctrines. Modal interior operators are characterised as particular adjoints in the 2-category 𝐃𝐭𝐧 \mathbf{Dtn} . We show that they can be constructed from comonads in 𝐃𝐭𝐧 \mathbf{Dtn} as well as from adjunctions in it, and the two constructions compare.

arxiv-2112-04678.description: Abstract Through the Backyard Worlds: Planet 9 citizen science project we discovered a late-type L dwarf co-moving with the young K0 star BD+60 1417 at a projected separation of 37 ″ \arcsec or 1662 AU. arxiv-2205-04112.title: On Generalisability of Machine Learning-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems
arxiv-2205-04112.creator: Siamak Layeghy 1 , Marius Portmann 2
arxiv-2205-04112.description: Abstract Many of the proposed machine learning (ML) based network intrusion detection systems (NIDSs) achieve near perfect detection performance when evaluated on synthetic benchmark datasets. Though, there is no record of if and how these results generalise to other network scenarios, in particular to real-world networks.

arxiv-2307-01299.title: The Evolution of Substance Use Coverage in the Philadelphia Inquirer
arxiv-2307-01299.creator: Layla Bouzoubaa, Ramtin Ehsani, Preetha Chatterjee, Rezvaneh Rezapour
arxiv-2307-01299.description: Abstract The media’s representation of illicit substance use can lead to harmful stereotypes and stigmatization for individuals struggling with addiction, ultimately influencing public perception, policy, and public health outcomes. To explore how the discourse and coverage of illicit drug use changed over time, this study analyzes 157,476 articles published in the Philadelphia Inquirer over a decade.

arxiv-2402-07769.title: Observations of the new meteor shower from comet 46P/Wirtanen
arxiv-2402-07769.creator: D. Vida ,, J. M. Scott, A. Egal, J. Vaubaillon, Q.-Z. Ye, D. Rollinson, M. Sato, D. E. Moser
arxiv-2402-07769.description: Abstract Context. A new meteor shower λ \lambda -Sculptorids produced by the comet 46P/Wirtanen was forecast for December 12, 2023. The predicted activity was highly uncertain, but generally considered to be low. Observations in Australia, New Zealand, and Oceania were solicited to help constrain the size distribution of meteoroids in the shower. Aims.

arxiv-2409-09441.title: PIP-Loco: A Proprioceptive Infinite Horizon Planning Framework for Quadrupedal Robot Locomotion
arxiv-2409-09441.creator: Aditya Shirwatkar ∗1 , Naman Saxena ∗1 , Kishore Chandra 1 , Shishir Kolathaya 2
arxiv-2409-09441.description: Abstract A core strength of Model Predictive Control (MPC) for quadrupedal locomotion has been its ability to enforce constraints and provide interpretability of the sequence of commands over the horizon. However, despite being able to plan, MPC struggles to scale with task complexity, often failing to achieve robust behavior on rapidly changing surfaces.

arxiv-2505-12174.title: On 𝔪 \mathfrak{m} -adic Continuity of F F -Splitting Ratio
arxiv-2505-12174.creator: Maria Akter
arxiv-2505-12174.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maria Akter. We investigate the \mathfrak{m} -adic continuity of Frobenius splitting dimensions and ratios for divisor pairs (R,\Delta) in an F -finite local ring (R,\mathfrak{m},k) of prime characteristic p>0 . Our main result states that if R is an F -finite, \mathbb{Q} -Gorenstein, Cohen-Macaulay local ring of prime characteristic p>0 , the Frobenius splitting numbers a^{\Delta}_{e}(R) remain unchanged under a suitable small perturbation. Moreover, we establish a desirable inequality of Frobenius splitting dimensions under general perturbations.

arxiv-2509-25121.title: Accelerating Dynamic Image Graph Construction on FPGA for Vision GNNs
arxiv-2509-25121.creator: Anvitha Ramachandran, Dhruv Parikh, Viktor Prasanna
arxiv-2509-25121.description: Abstract Vision Graph Neural Networks (Vision GNNs, or ViGs) represent images as unstructured graphs, achieving state-of-the-art performance in computer vision tasks such as image classification, object detection, and instance segmentation. Dynamic Image Graph Construction (DIGC) builds image graphs by connecting patches (nodes) based on feature similarity, and is dynamically repeated in each ViG layer following GNN-based patch (node) feature updates.

arxiv-2512-03239.creator: Josephine F.W. Baggen, Pieter van Dokkum, Ivo Labbé, Gabriel Brammer
arxiv-2512-03239.description: Abstract We present a luminous Little Red Dot (LRD) at z = 6.027 z=6.027 , doubly imaged by the galaxy cluster Abell 383 and observed with JWST/NIRCam. The source shows the characteristic “V-shaped” SED and pronounced Balmer break that define the LRD population.

pmc-10575071.creator: Arkadiusz Czarnuch, Marek Stembalski, Tomasz Szydłowski, Damian Batory
pmc-10575071.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Road simulators enable accelerated durability tests under similar-to-real road conditions. However, the road simulator itself generates the signals with the appropriate strength and amplitude that is adequate to the response registered by the sensors during the real run. Therefore, there is a need for verification of the validity of the representation of vehicle runs on a road simulator in terms of the shape of the generated profile and possible sources of uncertainty.

pmc-11378754.description: BackgroundThe incidence rate of adolescent depression and anxiety has been increasing since the outbreak of COVID-19, which there are no effective therapeutic drugs available. However, improper management of extrusion parameters such as the barrel temperature, feed moisture content, pressure, and other parameters of the extruder can influence the quality of extruded snack foods.

pmc-12498189.creator: Siang Yew Yeo, Fu Yuen Thong
pmc-12498189.description: BackgroundThe sinus tarsi approach (STA) is a well-established technique for treating displaced intra-articular calcaneal fractures (DIACFs) due to its reduced wound complication rates compared to the extensile lateral approach. However, concerns remain regarding the efficacy and safety of STA when performed beyond the 14-day post-injury mark.

pmc-12848012.creator: Tim Rasmussen, Jannik Küspert, Lars Schönemann, Dietmar Geiger, Bettina Böttcher
pmc-12848012.description: Proteins of the Drosophila behaviour/human splicing (DBHS) family are involved in many aspects of gene regulation and maintenance like transcription, splicing and DNA repair. DBHS proteins form obligate homo- and heterodimers through interactions within a globular domain and can further dynamically oligomerise through α-helical coiled-coils, which is crucial for many functions.

pmc-13103099.title: Predictive modeling for early diagnosis of dementia using sequential data analysis and data mining
pmc-13103099.creator: Senthil Kumar G, Dhanagopal R
pmc-13103099.description: Dementia, a progressively debilitating neurodegenerative disorder, poses a growing challenge to global healthcare due to its subtle early onset and lack of accurate temporal diagnostic models. Traditional machine learning (ML) approaches for dementia prediction, including SVMs, Random Forests, and CNNs, often rely on static, cross-sectional data that fail to capture the progressive cognitive decline observed in real-world patient trajectories.
